name: Te o Tsunaide Hakaba made
original_name: 手をつないで墓場まで
source:
Countless images of him smiled at me innocently
So that he could rest in peace, I held out a white flower as an offering

Seemingly happy, he smiled once again

[Translated from the [url=http://xxxmemo.web.fc2.com/g12.html]official website[/url]]
translation:
无数张他对我纯真微笑的照片
为了让他安息，我献上一朵白花作为供品

看上去很高兴，他又笑了

[翻译自[url=http://xxxmemo.web.fc2.com/g12.html]官网[/url]]
